explanation: It took 30 years to finish and was inaugurated in 1836, long after his fall. Since 1921 France's Unknown Soldier has lain beneath it, beside an eternal flame.

claims.text: Napoleon ordered the Arc de Triomphe in Paris in 1806, after the Battle of Austerlitz, to honour his army.
The Eiffel Tower, the Panthéon and Sacré-Cœur were not ordered by Napoleon after Austerlitz.
The Arc de Triomphe was inaugurated in 1836, 30 years after Napoleon ordered it.
France's Unknown Soldier was buried beneath the Arc de Triomphe in 1921, and an eternal flame burns there.
